title: Selena Gomez admits ‘stupid’ vaping habit permanently changed her voice

blocks.text: American singer-actress Selena Gomez has publicly declared that she has stopped vaping after the habit caused permanent changes to her speaking and singing voice. In an Instagram Story video on Oct 18, the 34-year-old admitted that she “vaped nicotine a lot.” The voice change is irreversible, said Gomez who, with 402 million followers, is the most followed woman on Instagram. “I’m not going to be able to change my voice,” she added, while warning those who are considering trying vaping. “If you’re going through it or if you’re even trying to vape, it’s just not worth it.
